_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Disks
slots.help: The game's floppy disks: .adf files (or .adz and .dms, which are packed ones, or .fdi). The first is in the drive when the Amiga is switched on; the others wait their turn, for the games that ask for another disk. Your files are never changed: the Amiga writes to copies of them in its memory.

slots.title: Disc
slots.help: The game's CD: a .cue sheet with its track files (.bin), or an .iso of a disc that has only data. It is read as it is and never changed.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The save memory of the CD32 (1 KB, where its games keep their saves) or of the CDTV (its battery-backed memory, kept as a file of 32 KB), as Export Save Data writes it: cd32.nvr or cdtv.nvr. Without one the machine starts with its save memory empty.
